decision: Logs are structured JSON with service, level, trace id and typed attributes
why: Structured fields can be queried and aggregated; free text cannot.
value: Queries like service:orders-api level:warn answer questions directly.

decision: A query bar with field:value filters and one-click examples
why: Engineers type faster than they click; examples teach the syntax.
value: From question to answer in one line.

decision: Level facets with live counts; debug hidden by default
why: Counts show the shape of the problem before reading a single line.

decision: The live tail is derived from world events in the browser and capped at 300 lines
why: Streaming real logs to every visitor would cost money and memory.
value: A believable tail at $0, pausable like every live screen.
